column1: # Words for Nihongo::Words (python main.py --seed-words), in study order.

# built on Jonathan Waller's JLPT lists, CC BY). Part of speech and the order within
# each level (newspaper frequency, nf): JMdict (EDRDG, CC BY-SA 4.0). Words that had
# a Notion card keep its meaning and notes; Notion-only words come first (greetings),
# travel words last (user, 2026-11-04). Verbs are left out: they come from verbs.tsv.
# Columns: level (n5/n4/blank), word, kana, meaning, type, note. The first word
# using a kana feature the kana decks lack (small っ, ー, ティ...) explains it in its note.
